ns2:course.label: Health Promotion Practicum
ns2:course.description: Preparation and presentation of lifestyle workshops to campus community groups. Practica selected from one or more of the following topics: chemical education, sexuality, stress management or campus acquaintance rape education (CARE). May be repeated up to a maximum of 6 hours. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Junior standing, or consent of instructor.
